lines: Chain 11 is read whole and on origin main (`7e543b87`), five merges: summer's tree sixth pass, summer's air (the take over into summer), spring's base second list, fall's base second list, the review page's dates. On it: tsc exit 0, build exit 0, the whole vitest 63 files passed and 1 skipped, 888 tests passed and 4 skipped; "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.9539"; "pass M3 spring-rest: 0.7655"; "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.7226 (threshold 0.75, detail.minSharpnessRatio)", up from 0.6996 and still a failure; M4 and M5 pass for the four shakes; winter's two draft stills unchanged and the six others changed; triangles at high winter 1,490,555, spring 1,450,250, summer 1,714,516, fall 1,791,095 of 1,800,000; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass.

Chain 12 is being read on four more merges that are not on origin main yet (local `1a8b6678`): winter's glints second list, fall's air second list, summer's sand fourth list, and the shutter's mend for frames that travel. Read so far: build exit 0, engine `1ea036d88a7e37e5`; "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.9539" (base 1.021, miniature 0.954); "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.7226", unchanged, since the air is not in that line; the change of season at draft: M4 0.9694, 0.9049, 0.9546, 0.9594 and M5 0.993, 1, 0.9653, 0.9997 for shakes 1 to 4, all pass. Still to come: the eight stills, the counts, the whole vitest.

Picture 1 is the shutter's mend at 3840 by 2160, film frame 631 (winter into spring), the tree's lights at two times: before above, each light drawn as a row of beads; with the mend below, each light one streak. Its builder's eight other pictures show the dots gone on the lamp, the icicles, the inside's lights and the glass's outline (seen by me); the table's mirror image is as before. The mend is in the final tier only and only in a frame that travels 6 px or more: 798 of film B's 3,600 frames and 131 of the loop's, samples up 2.7 percent for film B, rest frames at 3840 byte equal with and without it (all STATED by its builder). Not shown yet and ordered as its second list: frames either side of the 6 px floor, shakes 2 to 4, the table's mirror image, the same bytes through the masters' own path.

Picture 2 is fall's air: approved left, main before in the middle, the second list right. The leaves now read as leaves and the specks are fewer. Below the bar: the leaves are pale ochre and flat where the approved's are vivid orange and rust with lit edges, the sparks are soft where the approved's have white hot cores, three large bats sit high in the dome where the approved shows two small ones, the upper air is an even grey green where the approved is darker teal with warm glows. Third list sent.

Picture 3 is summer's sand heap: the approved picture in the left column, the fourth list top right, main before bottom right. The form is nearer (no lobe, no hook) and the pour no longer steps from frame to frame at 3840 (STATED). Below the bar: the near face carries a hard blue grey triangle of shade where the approved is warm shade with a soft edge, the strewn grains read as dots of one size, the dragged grains are not begun. The shade now goes first in its order.

Picture 4 is winter at 3840 final beside the frond, film frames 30 and 31: before above with a pale wedge in frame 30, with the mend below. The rows of white dots on the rim's frost in the shake are mended too (STATED, pictures seen by me). Not mended: the pond's fine detail still changes from frame to frame (0.604 by its builder's measure where 0.8 was asked); a third try by another way is ordered, in winter's own files only: fade what is finer than a pixel by its own footprint instead of drawing more samples.

The three pronged sand grains of film frame 1875 are settled as the sand's own: the shutter's builder showed the frame travels 4.66 px, under its floor, and that the figure comes from the 24 lens points over a blur of 4 to 5 px, which a spread along the motion cannot fill; the lying grains get a sprite that carries its own blur, as the flakes do.

Lines from builders (STATED, nothing pushed): summer's base has its fitted table smooth (worst step between neighbours 1.74 fold) and all fourteen boxes within 12 levels, still browner and darker than the approved's cream by its builder's own eye, the other cameras drawn again before its push by 04:00 UTC; summer's tree seventh list has winding tapered boughs and a stem in a slow S, its first trial filled the crown to one solid block and is being cut back to thin creases, push by 04:15 UTC.

Housekeeping: old helper pictures cleared, 3.4 GB of disk free here (open item 249 stays open; the masters will be joined on a helper machine). Open item 252 is new: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end; the root tries again from a turn that is not a run.

15 agents are at work at 03:20 UTC: summer (tree, miniature, air, glass, sand, base), fall (miniature, base, air), spring (base), winter's glints, the change of season, the controls, the shutter, the table's petals.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 11's eight draft stills; chain 12's two review stills and the change's measure at the draft tier so far. On helper machines: the builders' own stills and frames. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
